name: DannLaw (New York/New Jersey office)
what_they_do: Consumer-protection and civil-litigation firm founded in 2008, headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio, with a New York/New Jersey office in North Brunswick. Work is foreclosure defence, consumer class actions and individual suits against banks, lenders, debt collectors and servicers; the firm says it has resolved thousands of individual cases and hundreds of class actions and recovered over $100M for consumers. This North Brunswick office is one of four, and the site markets nationwide representation.
customers: Homeowners facing foreclosure, consumers with lender/servicer or debt-collection disputes, and small businesses; also class-action plaintiff groups nationwide.

size_signals.signal: Four offices listed: Cleveland OH (HQ), Dublin OH, Covington KY, and 825 Georges Road, Second Floor, North Brunswick NJ
Home page claims 2008 establishment, $100M+ recovered, 2,000+ business/home owners protected and 1,200+ attorneys trained
Dedicated Case Results, Testimonials, Blog and Practice Areas sections plus a live web chat widget

website_review.primary_cta: Sticky 'Free Consultation 216-366-7173' bar plus 'Discuss Your Case' buttons
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Case-details form (name, phone, e-mail, state, message) with 18 labels; live-chat widget offers 'Free Consultation' - no calendar booking
website_review.trust_signals: Case results, testimonials, named practice areas, firm history since 2008, recovery totals, attorney profiles
website_review.out_of_date_signs: No copyright year displayed; a cookie-consent modal covers the form on a 390px screen until accepted
website_review.search_basics: Title and description name consumer protection nationally but not the North Brunswick office; schema is a LegalService/Organization graph pointing at the Cleveland address only, with no New Jersey location; practice areas have their own pages on a separate contact-us subdomain for intake
top_issues: Local schema and phone are Cleveland-only, so the North Brunswick office is invisible in local search
Main phone number is an Ohio area code for a New Jersey office
Cookie banner sits on top of the case form on mobile
No appointment scheduling - a phone call or form is still required

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: Google reviews exist (3.7 from 12 per Birdeye) and Yoast robots.txt allows all crawlers with a sitemap index, but the JSON-LD Place/LegalService entity carries only the Cleveland address and geo-coordinates, so the NJ office has no local entity. Answerable: practice areas, firm history and case results are real text, and the contact page lists all four office addresses, but there are no hours and no fee/consultation terms beyond 'free consultation'. Bookable: Forminator form with 18 labels and no visible CAPTCHA (hidden iframes are about:blank), so an agent can submit case details - but there is no calendar and a chat widget, not a booking system, handles the rest.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Give the North Brunswick office its own local entity: NJ address, local phone or tracking number, hours and LocalBusiness schema, plus a dedicated New Jersey landing page
top_opportunities.evidence: JSON-LD Place uses 15000 Madison Ave, Cleveland OH with Ohio geo-coordinates; the header phone is 216-366-7173 and the NJ office appears only as text in the footer

top_opportunities.opportunity: Replace the two duplicated case forms and chat hand-off with one intake flow that screens case type, captures documents and auto-routes to the NJ attorney
top_opportunities.evidence: Contact page renders two identical Forminator forms and a chat widget offering 'Free Consultation' / 'I have a question'; no scheduling or document upload

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add consultation scheduling so foreclosure clients (a time-sensitive, high-anxiety enquiry) can pick a slot without a phone call
top_opportunities.evidence: Only phone, form and chat exist; no calendar or booking platform on the site

scores.reasons: Gap: technically solid site with forms and chat; the local-search and scheduling gaps are the real misses. Ability to pay: four-office firm with class-action revenue, well funded relative to the rest of this batch. Ease: WordPress stack with existing schema - adding an NJ entity and booking is quick. Evidence: read home and contact pages, JSON-LD, robots.txt and the 390px render.
